planets.name: TOI-1807 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1807 with a 0.549-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-1807 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1807. Its orbit and size follow MacDougall et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
